summary: SSH into the device manually and run show config to confirm credentials, which also adds the device's host key to known_hosts.
questions: How do I test my network device credentials before using Ansible?
Why should I SSH to the device manually first?

answer_card.title: Connect manually first
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ssh my_vyos_user@vyos.example.net
show config
exit
```
This confirms your credentials and adds the device's RSA fingerprint to known hosts.
